design_brief: 低像素侧视长战场，黄沙、独立钢墙路段、外露工厂与高楼；第一段上到高处后，地面持续延伸到后续各段，不再退回低地。只做背景图。

final_prompts.section_1:
Use case: precise-object-edit, continuous level elevation correction.
Edit this low-resolution pixel-art side-view battlefield background. The user wants a PERMANENT ELEVATION CHANGE IN THE MAIN GROUND, continuing across the following map images. This is NOT a series of isolated platforms.
Keep chunky very low-resolution square pixels, warm yellow sand, cool thick steel, exposed factories and high-rises, pale dusty sky, and wide 20:7 framing. Keep steel wall sections local, never a continuous fence obscuring the architecture. No people, UI, text, items, interactive props, stairs, ladders or collision markings.
REMOVE ALL FREESTANDING SMALL PLATFORMS, detached raised islands, jumping gaps, steel tables, open-underneath catwalks and places where the upper route drops back down. Replace with a single SOLID continuous raised landform: broad compacted earth/industrial foundation supported from the bottom of the canvas, a coherent concrete-and-steel retaining face, and yellow sand across the entire flat upper surface. The front retaining face is BELOW the ground, not an enclosing wall in front of factories. Buildings stand visibly on the raised ground; adjust their lower facades to meet the new ground level. The upper route should be broad and visually clearly continuous.
Shared joining rule for ALL three images: raised yellow sand ground edge at exactly 62 percent of canvas height. The last quarter of section 1 and ALL of sections 2 and 3 keep this EXACT same elevation with a level straight surface. No dip, descent, end cap, jump gap or return to the old low ground at section boundaries. Sand, foundation material, top-edge thickness and lighting should match at both edges.
SECTION 1: only the FAR LEFT starts on the original lower sand at 82 percent height. Between x=18% and x=42%, a broad sand-covered industrial embankment rises to the new higher ground at y=62%. From x=42% right to the RIGHT CANVAS EDGE, the ground stays on this continuous high plateau at y=62%, NEVER descending. The plateau and its solid supporting foundation visibly continue OFF THE RIGHT EDGE to the next image. Existing standalone steel wall is left, exposed factory is middle, building is right. Keep their material style. Integrate the new raised level with the factory base as one permanent industrial terrace, not a floating platform. Rightmost sand surface must be exactly at 62% height, with solid retaining mass filling everything below.

The player's ground is ALREADY HIGH when entering from the LEFT EDGE. Extend the high, yellow-sand-topped industrial terrace seen at the RIGHT EDGE OF IMAGE 2 seamlessly in concept across the ENTIRE WIDTH of this target, at the SAME y=62% height. It stays high from left edge to right edge. Absolutely NO entry ramp, down ramp, low sand route, detached platforms, holes or gaps. Fill everything below with the continuous solid retaining foundation matching reference: sand-earth fill between chunky concrete/steel vertical ribs, stone top band, shallow yellow sand covering. final_prompts.section_3:
Use case: background replacement preserving foreground.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET AND GEOMETRY MASTER. Image 2 is ONLY the desired high-rise skyline/architecture reference.
Keep the ENTIRE FOREGROUND TERRAIN OF IMAGE 1 UNCHANGED: every pixel from the yellow sandy ground top at about 63 percent image height down to the bottom edge, including ground height, thickness, stone top strip, earth retaining face, all vertical supporting columns, and the shallow sand strip at the very bottom. Preserve the exact image dimensions and pixel grid. Do not move or resize this terrain at all.
Change ONLY the background ABOVE that sandy top edge: replace the factory-dominant skyline of image 1 with the exposed tall damaged towers and low factory wing of image 2. The split-top tower is the landmark, the small factory stays on left. Buildings rise naturally behind/on the high terrace, their base at its yellow sand top. Preserve image 1's warm dusty beige atmosphere and its very coarse square pixel art, limited colors and blocky clouds. No continuous steel enclosure in front of buildings. The result is the NEXT section of the same long elevated route, with completely unchanged level ground running all the way left to right. Do not add ramps, separate platforms, gaps, stairs or a lower path. Pure background PNG, no people, UI, text, interactables or collision overlays.
